chunks: So We delivered him and Lot, and brought them to the land We had blessed for all the people.
ai.seo_question: Who did Allah deliver and bring to the blessed land for all the people?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'Najat' (salvation/deliverance) not merely as physical rescue but as a transition to a sacred space of divine proximity, specifically linking Ibrahim and Lut to the land of blessing which many scholars identify as the Holy Land or specifically Mecca/Medina. The phrase 'for the worlds' (lil-'alamin) signifies that their preservation serves as a universal archetype of faith and guidance, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the continuity of prophetic leadership and the sanctity of the earth as a locus for divine manifestation.
